deps.edn.reason: Git dependencies on kami-* repositories become one source each so the same namespaces are not loaded twice: kami-eizo-timeline is the local root under packages/, and kami-ongaku-project is the kotoba monorepo's lib/kotoba.kamiOngakuProject at the same kotoba pin as the other kotoba libraries (its packages/ copy was a duplicate and was removed, JUN-649). The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (dep org.clojure/clojure, alias :cljs, alias :pages, alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :e2e): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.
